name: Sujata Mishra/ସୁଜାତା ମିଶ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sujata Mishra writes poetry in Odia and English. Kabita Live’s contributor introduction notes her poetry collections, while her contribution here offers a concentrated encounter with absence and the difficulty of being understood.

In “କେହି ଜଣେ ନଥିବା ପରି”, the speaker moves through images of an evening within the mind, a crumpled heart and someone passing beyond reach. The closing sequence leaves words unspoken and songs unsung, allowing grief and unfulfilled happiness to remain unresolved. Against this intimate disturbance, the earth continues on its axis: the poem holds personal heartbreak beside the world’s unbroken motion.
